subject.title: feat(plugins): upgrade llm_input/llm_output hooks from fire-and-forget to modifying

question: Should OpenClaw accept mutating `llm_input`/`llm_output` hooks as the model-bound plugin policy surface, or should prompt/response rewriting stay in narrower lifecycle hooks such as `before_agent_run` and prompt-build hooks?
rationale: This PR changes a public plugin API and lets enabled plugins alter model-bound data and returned assistant text, so automation should not choose the trust boundary, precedence, audit behavior, or permanent hook layer without maintainer intent.

options.title: Require a designed LLM I/O API
options.body: Keep the direction possible but require a current-main rewrite with explicit timeout, transcript, docs, SDK, and security semantics before merge.

options.title: Route rewriting elsewhere
options.body: Close or defer this PR and use `before_agent_run` or prompt-build prompt-replacement work for blocking and prompt mutation instead.

options.title: Accept this hook layer as-is after fixes
options.body: Maintain the `llm_input`/`llm_output` API direction but ask the contributor to repair the blocking findings and provide current-head proof.

recommendation.title: Require a designed LLM I/O API
recommendation.body: Keep the direction possible but require a current-main rewrite with explicit timeout, transcript, docs, SDK, and security semantics before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent has recent history on the relevant hook files and is the strongest available owner for a cross-runner plugin API/security decision.
